content: The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) provides comprehensive resources and guidance on diabetes prevention, management, and care. Below are detailed descriptions of the topics covered: 1. Preventing and Managing Type 2 Diabetes: Explore strategies for you and your family to work together in preventing or managing type 2 diabetes effectively. This includes lifestyle changes and collaborative approaches to health. 2. Recognizing Symptoms of Diabetes: Understand the specific signs and symptoms associated with type 1 diabetes, type 2 diabetes, and gestational diabetes. Early recognition is critical for timely diagnosis and management. 3. Type 1 Diabetes Overview: Gain detailed knowledge about type 1 diabetes, including its symptoms, diagnostic testing, treatment options, and long-term management strategies. 4. Type 2 Diabetes Overview: Learn about type 2 diabetes, including its risk factors, methods for prevention, and effective management techniques to control the condition. For Healthcare Professionals: 5. Preventing Type 2 Diabetes Through Patient Education: Access an infographic that provides evidence-based facts and strategies for discussing lifestyle changes with patients to prevent type 2 diabetes. 6. Referring Patients to Diabetes Self-Management Education and Support (DSMES): Understand how DSMES programs can improve health outcomes, including better glycemic control (A1C levels), for patients with diabetes. 7. Promoting Ear Health in Diabetes Patients: Receive guidance on how to address and promote ear health in patients with diabetes, as they may be at increased risk for related complications. 8. Promoting Eye Health in Diabetes Patients: Learn how to guide patients in maintaining eye health, including the prevention and management of diabetes-related eye conditions such as diabetic retinopathy. 9. Promoting Foot Health in Diabetes Patients: Access recommendations for preventing and managing foot complications in patients with diabetes, including proper foot care and regular checkups. 10. Promoting Medication Management: Obtain guidance on how to support patients in managing their diabetes medications effectively, ensuring adherence and optimizing treatment outcomes. 11. Promoting Oral Health in Diabetes Patients: Learn strategies to help patients maintain oral health, as diabetes can increase the risk of gum disease and other oral health issues. Featured Topics: 12. Living Well with Diabetes: Discover practical tips to help individuals live a healthy and fulfilling life while managing diabetes. 13. Preventing Diabetes Complications: Learn how self-care practices and regular medical checkups can help prevent or delay complications associated with diabetes. 14. Healthy Eating for Diabetes: Access resources on meal planning, carbohydrate counting, reading food labels, and making informed choices while grocery shopping to support diabetes management. 15. Achieving a Healthy Weight: Find tips to help individuals reach and maintain a healthy weight, which is essential for overall well-being and diabetes control. 16. Preventing Type 2 Diabetes: Understand how prediabetes serves as a critical warning sign and learn how to assess your risk for developing type 2 diabetes. 17. Key Questions for Your Healthcare Team: Equip yourself with five essential questions to ask your healthcare providers to ensure your diabetes care plan remains effective and on track. 18. Managing Blood Sugar Levels: Access detailed information on when and how to test blood sugar levels, as well as strategies for managing hyperglycemia (high blood sugar) and hypoglycemia (low blood sugar).
